 Advocate.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.

This Application has been filed by the applicant Allah Rakha for anticipatory bail in the First Information Report bearing registration no. 114 of 2025, registered at Police Station Sahaspur,
District Dehradun under Section 409 and Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
According to the First Information Report dated 29.05.2025, payment was made to one Asgar Ali from 21.01.2024 to 03.02.2024 whereas he died on 13.02.2022.
There is also an allegation in the First Information Report that the applicant has embezzled Rs.1,75,981/-.

3. Heard Mr. Rajat Mittal, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Pradeep Lohani, learned Brief Holder for the respondent and Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, learned counsel for the informant.
4.
Mr. Rajat Mittal, Advocate, contended that the present applicant was elected as a member of Kshetra Panchayat, Rampur Kalan.
For construction of road under MNREGA Scheme, 58 workers had submitted their applications for work by way of Form-6.
The name of Asgar Ali was also shown in the said Form-6.
The Program Officer / Block Development Officer issued Form-7 assigning work to the workers including to Asgar Ali.
When the applicant came to know that Asgar Ali died on 13.02.2022 and his attendance was wrongly marked, he informed the said fact to the concerned Officer.
Then, the payment was stopped.

A Committee was constituted and after a detailed inquiry,

sentences.text: 1 fund.
5. Mr. Pradeep Lohani, Brief Holder for the respondent and Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate for the informant have sought three weeks' time to file objections to the anticipatory bail application.
6. Time is granted.

7. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant Allah Rakha, he shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties,
each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.

8. List on 11.07.2025 for hearing on the anticipatory bail application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
